key_detail: migration 0002 in commit de45f63 dropped the index ix_order_items_order_id on order_items(order_id); the per-order item count on GET /orders now does a sequential scan of order_items for every order listed
red_herrings: api settings commit (catalog cache TTL) deployed to the api about four minutes before the slowdown
'slow request' WARNINGs on /checkout that also occur in the healthy period
expected_fix: recreate the index on order_items(order_id) (new migration or CREATE INDEX) and keep both indexes declared in the model
notes: No ERROR is logged; first_error_ts is the time the culprit commit was made, the migration runs a few seconds later. Evidence is latency_ms on GET /orders (about 80 ms before, about 600 ms after) with status 200, plus 'slow request' WARNINGs on /orders. The api is not restarted by the culprit deploy; only the worker is. GET /orders/{id} is also slower but stays under the slow-request threshold.
